notes.title: Update 1.4.1 - Major Update
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the latest update for our game, packed with exciting new features and improvements inspired by your valuable feedback.

[h2]New Game Mode: Rescue[/h2]
Engage yourself in our brand-new PvE experience where you battle against AI opponents. Your mission objective is to rescue the hostage by disarming the bomb before the time runs out. We also added a dedicated leaderboard to track your Rescue mode performance. Some maps now feature procedural elements, ensuring every playthrough feels fresh and dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937688/0a077a30a7b5f77991ce530b8ae15bcacac6d7e2.gif[/img]

[h2]Multi-Language Support[/h2]
Added support for multiple languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Deutsch
[*] 简体中文
[*] Español
[*] Français
[*] Italiano
[*] Português (Brasileiro)
[*] 日本語
[*] 한국어
[*] Русский
[*] Українська
[*] Polski
[*] čeština
[*] Türkçe
[/list]
[h2]Experimental Bodycam Effect[/h2]
We added an experimental bodycam-like post-processing visual effect that creates a more immersive first-person experience.

[b]NOTE:[/b] This effect can only be activated from the main menu. It may impact performance and might cause visual artifacts in some scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937688/d9ec77c41eec9b11f91524dcb94997a92617fef2.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the HUD would not display upon respawn in certain scenarios.
[/list]


[b]Good luck out there![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.3.1 and Demo Shutdown
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce that [b]Update 1.3.1[/b] is now live for all players!

[h1]Update 1.3.1[/h1]

This update includes a brand new map. As requested by the community, the map is set in a modern environment - who wouldn't want to shoot metal in their brand-new home? Like every map, the zombie mode features modified lighting, so make sure to only enter equipped with a gun that has a flashlight attached. Additionally, this update includes some bug fixes - see the release notes below for details.

[h2]Full Release Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a new map available for all game modes
[*] Fixed a font issue in the leaderboard where some usernames were not displayed correctly
[*] Fixed a bug in the door system where doors became blocked if the player went through the exit first
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to kick doors without them opening
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the aim point of the weapon to be off-center in rare cases
[/list]

[h1]Demo Shutdown[/h1]

As mentioned in our previous post, the demo will be taken offline as of the time of this update. Managing two builds simultaneously consumes too many resources.

The [b]next major update will bring even more exciting content[/b]! Be sure to join our Discord to stay up-to-date with regular development updates.

[b]Good luck with the new map - and don't forget to check upstairs![/b]

notes.title: Current State of the Game, Update 1.2.1, and Demo Shutdown
notes.content:
It's been almost a week since the game's launch, and we want to thank every single player for playing and sharing your experiences and feedback!

We take feedback seriously and have already released two hotfixes shortly after release. Now, we're excited to introduce our first minor content update, which includes Steam Leaderboards.

[h2]Update 1.2.1[/h2]

With the release of version 1.2.1, there will be three global leaderboards. After each successful round in either Target Rush or Zombie Mode, your score will be submitted to the global leaderboard. However, only your top score will remain on the list.

[list]
[*] Target Rush Score: The total score of a full Target Rush run. For example, if you've played three levels, the sum of those levels scores will be submitted to the leaderboard.
[*] Zombie Mode Score: Calculated the same way as the Target Rush Score.
[*] Score Per Minute: This leaderboard introduces a time element. Your total score for the current run will be divided by the sum of the run time. 
[/list]

Currently, difficulty only affects the points awarded for unlocking new weapons and maps (Easy 25% less, Hard 50% more points). This may change in the future to also impact leaderboards based on user feedback. The in-game leaderboard will be limited to 100 entries (50% above and 50% below the player entry). You can see the full leaderboard on Steam - Global Leaderboards.

[b]Please note - you need to complete one successful round in corresponding game mode to get access to the leaderboards in game![/b]

[h3]Full Release Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added integration for Steam Leaderboards.
[*] Added volume control in settings to lower zombie sounds.
[/list]

[h2]Demo Shutdown[/h2]

We also need to mention that the demo will be taken down by the end of the month, as maintaining two builds consumes too many resources. You won't be able to start it from Steam anymore, but it will still be visible for uninstallation.



As mentioned, we take feedback seriously and are already working on new content for you to enjoy.

[b]Step up and climb the ranks of the global leaderboard![/b]

notes.title: Game Release and Patch v1.1.3
notes.content:
We're excited and proud that Tactical Mission: Target Rush was released today! Thanks to everyone who supported us, gave feedback and helped us making this game!

Here are the patch notes for the release build:

[list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Fixed micro stutter on mouse movement (this was only occurring on some hardware devices in a specific DPI range)
[*] Added widescreen resolutions in settings
[*] Reduced player idle breathing movement (this makes longer shots less difficult)
[*] Fixed holo sight offset (aim at 25-50m was slightly off, making longer shots inaccurate)
[*] Improved weapon precision
[/list]

We wish everyone fun playing while shooting some metal & zombies!

notes.title: Public Demo Update - v1.0.2
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release of update v1.0.2 for the demo! Thank you for all the support over the last few months. This is the last major update for the demo (excluding bug fixes) and will represent the final state of the game with limited content. More weapons and maps will be included in the full release. 

[list]
[*] Added progression system
[*] Added new target types
[*] Added new uniforms for player character
[*] Added key bind changes and new settings
[*] Added tutorial
[*] Added head for player
[*] Changed weapon customization to unlockable weapon variations
[*] Changed door system
[*] Changed base map
[*] Reworked player movement and animations
[*] Reworked UI
[*] Numerous small changes and bug fixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update. Feel free to provide feedback via the in-game submission form, on Steam, or on our Discord server.

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you like it!
